content: In the body of the main paper, we present the results of the original model and date-adjusted models of BIBREF8 , as well as our textual and multiplex cluster results. The readers can refer to the original paper of BIBREF8 for complete details on variable operationalization and model specification. We focus here on the performance of the models.
